items.title: Gurmeet Chaddha shares top investment ideas; Explains why he likes Lenskart, Meesho & Ather Energy
items.description: Gurmeet Chaddha, Managing Partner & CIO at Complete Circle, shares his outlook for Indian equities and expects a strong market rally in the second half of the year. In this interview, Chaddha discusses his top investment ideas and explains why he remains positive on consumer and new-age businesses such as Lenskart, Meesho and Ather Energy. He also shares his views on the broader market, sectoral opportunities and the key themes investors should watch going forward. From valuations and earnings to India’s consumption story, Chaddha highlights the factors that could drive the next leg of the market rally and shares his preferred stocks for the current environment.

items.title: Brent Oil close to $90|HDFC Bank in Focus after Jagdishan decides to not see re-appointment
items.description:
Global markets turn cautious as fresh US-Iran military escalation stokes fears of a wider conflict and sends oil prices higher, with Brent crude nearing $90 a barrel. Wall Street futures trade 0.3-0.6% lower after the US struck rocket launcher locations on Larak Island, while Iran retaliated by targeting US bases in Jordan. Asian markets also remain under pressure, with the Kospi falling over 2% and the Nikkei down 1.5%.
Rate hike worries add to the risk-off mood after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech pushed September rate hike expectations to 57% from 35%, according to the CME FedWatch Tool. US Treasury yields climbed, while gold fell 3.5%. AI stocks weighed on Wall Street, with Nvidia down 4.5% and Marvell Technology plunging 10.3%.
For Indian markets, Gift Nifty signals a lower opening. The Nifty is heading for its third straight weekly decline, its longest losing streak in five months.
